body.name: Constant-\(X\) finite-feature inverse handle
body.construction: Use \(\mathfrak I_0\): when \(X\) is degenerate, differentiate the normalized three-view feature tensor and invert its separated finite Jacobian on the observed score image to recover centered scores for \(\pi\), \(M_A\), \(M_Z\), and \(\Gamma_Y\)
